facts.fact: EGPAF reports that Mchinji Health Center now uses an electronic medical record system that clinicians log into at the point of care, having used paper folders until 2019.
EGPAF reports that Mchinji Health Center, a health centre, records patient care in an electronic medical record system connected to a laboratory information management system.
